scope: Native-geometry construction and feasibility against immutable saved R_RampIntake_R3_Stowed.step. No production source/STEP, rendering, airflow, engine, thermal, strength, continuous-motion, or visual-approval claim.

sections.section_construction_note: RectangleRounded local XY was rotated +90deg about world Y; its local X dimension was assigned heightZ and local Y dimension widthY.

saved_intake_stub_box_mm.source: saved R1 cutter dimensions carried into immutable R3 body

external_stowed_envelope.basis: Saved R3 nonbody parts are immutable; aft cut changes only body material inside declared cutters.
